Durg–Raipur–Arang Highway | Arang Interchange | Construction Update
In this video, we take a detailed aerial look at the *Arang Interchange,* being developed as part of *Package-B* of the *Durg–Raipur–Arang Highway project* in Chhattisgarh, India.
The *Durg–Raipur–Arang Highway* is an approximately 92 km long, six-lane access-controlled corridor being developed to serve as a bypass for Durg & Raipur, helping improve regional connectivity & reducing traffic congestion on existing routes.
